quotes.text: # Collect payment details before creating an Intent
Build an integration where you can render the Payment Element prior to creating a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: The `amount` passed to the Payment Element should reflect what a customer will be charged immediately.
For subscriptions that don’t collect a payment up front (for example, subscriptions with a free trial period), use the client secret from the `pending_setup_intent`.

findings: The November exact-URL capture is a 15-line variant index, not a replacement implementation guide. New raw:9-15 links the web payment, setup, and subscription variants. Its omission of the old guide's technical text is a presentation/navigation change; it does not establish deprecation, changed API behavior, or current variant implementation. Keep this navigation-only capture outside factual raw_files if linked at all.

The earlier same-URL capture contains all three variant bodies: payment begins old raw:8; setup begins old raw:736; subscription begins old raw:1584 and continues to EOF at old raw:2490. The current source summary at line 13 says it covers 'both payment and setup flows', and Stripe index line 557 and stripe-payment-intents concept line 146 likewise label only payment+setup. Correct those discoverability claims to include the dated subscription branch; this is a pre-existing retained-source omission, not a new behavior proved by the November index.

The old subscription variant sets Elements mode='subscription' and says its displayed amount should equal the immediate charge, including 0 for a trial (old raw:1660-1669,1701-1718). It creates a Subscription using a Price and Customer or customer-configured Account, with payment_behavior='default_incomplete' (old raw:2235-2267,2287-2311). It chooses pending_setup_intent.client_secret for no upfront payment versus latest_invoice.confirmation_secret.client_secret for the payment branch, then calls confirmSetup or confirmPayment according to returned type (old raw:2241,2269-2279,2313-2323,2331-2333,2360-2379). A source correction should distinguish these states and not imply that rendering the Element, creating a Subscription, or receiving a client secret means a payment succeeded.

The old payment and setup branches retain distinct PaymentIntent and SetupIntent creation and confirmPayment versus confirmSetup after elements.submit (old raw:602-623,1208-1212,1306-1359). Payment fulfillment relies on payment_intent.succeeded webhooks rather than client callback alone (old raw:718-722). The November index does not reverify these instructions. The old guide also distinguishes Accounts v2 customer_account and Customers v1 customer examples, plus Accounts v2 preview/version qualifications (old raw:248-322,1122-1236,1455-1504).

The existing source's limitation line 39 should retain its client-side condition: old raw:29 says customer_balance with dynamic methods is unavailable when creating the deferred intent client-side because a customer-configured Account or Customer must be attached; a server-created PaymentIntent with that identity is its stated route. The old guide says BLIK and pre-authorized ACSS debit are unsupported on this integration path (old raw:29,757,1605). None of these are new November claims.
substantive_changes: No same-URL technical behavior change is established: the November capture is a navigation index (new raw:9-15). The required source update repairs the already-present but omitted subscription variant in the dated old 2,490-line guide (old raw:1584-2490).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Payment mode: render Elements before server-side PaymentIntent creation; submit/validate first, then use the returned client secret with confirmPayment (old raw:82-102,602-623).

Setup mode: set up a payment method without an immediate charge using SetupIntent and confirmSetup, attached to a Customer or customer-configured Account for future use (old raw:736-740,1122-1124,1208-1212,1339-1359).

Subscription mode: immediate-charge amount may be 0 for trial, and the pending setup versus invoice confirmation secret determines confirmSetup versus confirmPayment (old raw:1664,2241,2269-2279,2360-2379).
The old guide's Accounts v2 customer-account examples and Customers v1 customer examples have different identity and availability/version qualifications (old raw:248-322,1122-1236).
conflicts: Source line 13, Stripe index line 557, and stripe-payment-intents concept line 146 describe only payment and setup despite an entire subscription variant at old raw:1584-2490 and a November link at new raw:15.

Source line 39 compresses the customer_balance restriction; old raw:29 makes it conditional on client-side deferred-intent creation and specifies a server-side PaymentIntent with a customer-configured Account or Customer as the route.
unresolved_questions: The November index links but does not contain the current content of the three payment-ui variants, so current implementation details, account eligibility, and behavior cannot be inferred from it.

The old captured guide contains malformed or illustrative code fragments and preview-version examples; these are historical documentation evidence, not proof of a runnable integration or successful charge.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/accept-a-payment-deferred, November raw:9-15 is a variant index linking payment, setup, and subscription pages. The prior same-URL guide contains those three complete branches, starting at old raw:8,736,1584. [[source-stripe-accept-payment-deferred]] line 13 and its concept and index routes omit the subscription branch, so a bounded historical source correction is needed even though the new index provides no substantive implementation delta.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/accept-a-payment-deferred, preserve the old guide's distinct payment, setup, and subscription states. In the subscription branch, old raw:1664 says the Element amount reflects the immediate charge, old raw:2241 selects pending_setup_intent for a no-upfront-payment subscription, and old raw:2373 dispatches confirmSetup versus confirmPayment. [[source-stripe-accept-payment-deferred]] should expose that dated branch; new raw:13-15 only navigates to variants and does not revalidate their current instructions or prove a payment completed.
